scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @cleardesk/contracts && npm run build --workspace @cleardesk/api && npm run build --workspace @cleardesk/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/contracts/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p verification/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps packages scripts verification docs .github *.md *.json *.ts
scripts.format: prettier --write apps packages scripts verification docs .github *.md *.json *.ts
